title: Ivo and the Postcard
author: Kestrel Whitlock
blurb: Juniper Whitlock, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
